monster_goblin3.title: the
monster_goblin3.name: three-eyed hobgoblin
monster_goblin3.information: Bulging, putrid muscles and a distinctly too-many-eyed face. What the chernobyl type of fuck is this??
death_messages: He tears out his third eyeball, and shoves it in your throat. You suffocate painfully. You are dead.
He crushes your head with his bulging muscles. You are dead.

text.wind_up: {atk.name} rip{atk.s} out {atk.poss_adjective} third eye, which regrows instantly. Then, {atk.subject} throws it at {def.name}!
text.on_hit: The eye hits {def.name}, and splatters into heaps of toxic gunk and goo!
text.on_kill: The eye hits square, and {def.name} succumbs to the toxeyene!
text.on_armor_save: The eye leaves a stain on {def.owns} armor, but not much more.

text.wind_up: {atk.name} flex{atk.es} {atk.poss_adjective} muscles, popping several cysts on the biceps.
text.on_dodge: {atk.name} misses {def.name}, leaving only some light pus splatters on {def.object}
text.on_armor_save: {atk.name} break{atk.s} a few fingers as {atk.object} hit{atk.s} {def.owns} armor... They snap back right after.

monster_imp.title: the
monster_imp.name: imp
monster_imp.information: A nasty flying fucker who pokes you with its Pitchfork. It's a creature straight out of Hell!
death_messages: It pokes you into the gut, and uses its pitchfork to twirl your colon like spaghetti! You are dead.

text.wind_up: {atk.name} twirl{atk.s} {atk.poss_adjective} pitchfork around, ready to get stabbing.
text.on_kill: {atk.name} poke{atk.s} a hole into something important, and {def.name} collapse{def.s}!
